entities.summary: Santiago Alberto Lovell Birnes, known as Alberto Lovell, was an Argentine heavyweight boxer, who won the gold medal in the Olympic Games in Los Angeles 1932. In his career as a professional boxer he had 88 fights winning 76 losing 8 with 3 draws, He won both the Argentine and South American championships.
